title: Conditional Sentences: Mixed Tense Practice — Quiz 85
content:
## Conditional Sentences: Mixed Tense Practice

Put the verbs into the correct conditional forms.

### Lesson focus

1. You ___ your examination if you work hard. (pass)
2. If she had a little sense of humour, our life ___ a paradise. (be)
3. What would you do if God Himself ___ before you? (appear)
4. If I had seen the red light, I ___ . (stop)

### Understand the pattern

Use the stated time relationship to choose among first, second and third conditionals. A possible future condition normally takes present simple. An imagined present condition uses a past form; an imagined past condition uses had plus a past participle.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. will pass
2. would be
3. appeared
4. would have stopped

The first item concerns a possible future result. The second and third are hypothetical. The fourth looks back at a missed past event, so the result needs would have stopped.

### Try another

Complete: If I had noticed the message, I ___ sooner. (reply)

### Suggested answer

Would have replied. Had noticed establishes an unreal past condition, and would have replied gives the unreal past result.
